name: One object carries the story
description: One object (the career ladder in his cut; any one thing in a piece) carries every number, counted onto a part of it, with a slow push and crossfades on the word.

rated.words: They're all approved. I don't actually think these are the problem. I think how we integrate title cards and real-world images and motion animation is the issue.

rated_note: Krish's rating, written only by `python scripts/ve.py recipe rate <id> <score> --words "..."` ({score, by: Krish, on, words}) or `--approved` ({approved: true, by: Krish, on, words}, no score); null until he gives it. From 23 Nov 2026 ve lint uses only a recipe rated 9 or more or approved by him, or the piece's one named experiment (style.experiment) (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-19: recipes plus one named experiment slot; Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-20: all ten style combinations on the style board are approved; scripts/velib/floor.py).
generated_note: Generated (AI-made) imagery never appears in a cut (Krish, 2026-11-20), so no recipe names a generated kind and ve lint refuses any generated asset (floor.recipe_generated).
source: Krish's own cut Eating its own jobs, Mon 2 Nov 2026 (config/reference-cuts.json mon02-tall, sha256 2cdff09a); docs/ve/styles/eating-jobs-ladder.card.json
